title: SPI Mock Test – parents, 17–24 Oct
primaryText:
Is your child in 10th and aiming for NDA? SPI entrance practice should start now, not in the last month.

✅ Full 3-hour mock test every Sunday, 10 AM–1 PM
✅ Exam-pattern questions + a detailed performance report after every test
✅ See speed and accuracy improve week by week

📍 LWS Pune Defence Academy, Sagar Arcade, FC Road, Pune

Tap "Send message" to get the schedule and fees on WhatsApp.
